sentences.text: The genus name Evgenavis honors the Russian paleontologist Evgeny Kurochkin.
This animal belongs to the class Reptilia.
Scientists found only a single isolated tarsometatarsus, a specific leg bone.
It is potentially the only member of the Confuciusornithiformes clade found outside the Jehol Biota.
Phylogenetic analysis resolved Evgenavis as a member of the Enantiornithes.
The species is classified within the parent group Enantiornithes.
A 2019 study placed Evgenavis as the sister taxon to Longirostravis, which is generally considered a member of the family Longipterygidae.
Evgenavis existed between 125.77 and 113.2 million years ago.
